title: forge_reads does not cut a caller-injected runner at the total deadline, so BG-mhsmvdrz's 60 s bound holds only for the default runner and is unproven by its repro
goal: bl_stall.forge_reads ends within its deadline whatever runner it is given: bounded_run calls a caller-injected runner in a daemon thread and stops waiting for it when the time left is up (DeadlineReached, the ids left out are unknown:forge), starts no runner call once the deadline has passed, and still returns a fast runner's result, so a planted slow runner proves the bound

run:
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_stall
def slow(argv, cwd=None):
    time.sleep(3)
    return 1, ""
t = time.monotonic()
try:
    bl_stall.forge_reads(".", ["BG-aaaaaaaa"], run=slow, deadline_s=0.5)
except Exception as e:
    print("raised", type(e).__name__)
took = time.monotonic() - t
print("took %.1f s against a 0.5 s deadline" % took)
sys.exit(0 if took < 1.5 else 1)

import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_stall
calls = []
def slow(argv, cwd=None):
    calls.append(argv)
    time.sleep(2)
    return 1, ""
t = time.monotonic()
try:
    got = bl_stall.forge_reads(".", ["BG-aaaaaaaa", "BG-bbbbbbbb", "BG-cccccccc"], run=slow, deadline_s=0.4)
except Exception as e:
    print("raised", type(e).__name__); got = None
took = time.monotonic() - t
time.sleep(0.2)
print("took %.1f s against a 0.4 s deadline; runner called %d times; result %r" % (took, len(calls), got))
b = bl_stall.bounded_run(lambda a, cwd=None: (0, "x"), time.monotonic() + 5)
fast = tuple(b(["x"])) == (0, "x")
late = bl_stall.bounded_run(lambda a, cwd=None: (0, "x"), time.monotonic() - 1)
try:
    late(["x"]); started = True
except bl_stall.DeadlineReached:
    started = False
print("fast runner result kept:", fast, "; a call past the deadline starts none:", not started)
sys.exit(0 if took < 1.2 and len(calls) <= 1 and got == {} and fast and not started else 1)

clauses.clause: bl_stall.forge_reads ends within its deadline whatever runner it is given: bounded_run calls a caller-injected runner in a daemon thread and stops waiting for it when the time left is up (DeadlineReached, the ids left out are unknown:forge), starts no runner call once the deadline has passed
still returns a fast runner's result, so a planted slow runner proves the bound
